deployment.statement: This package PREPARES the governed staging release. The release itself — deployment ids, aliases, runtime proofs — is recorded in OC5R_STAGING_RELEASE_RECORD.json, never here.

candidate.frontend_sha: the deploy commit — code_sha itself, or a descendant that changes only docs/** and this branch's two governed pairing records
candidate.backend_sha: the same deploy commit as the frontend (one monorepo commit; the gates require frontend == backend == candidate head)

projects.stable_aliases: carup-staging.vercel.app and carup-backend-staging.vercel.app are NOT moved; the pair resolver refuses them as non-candidate origins
projects.git_auto_deploy: disabled (vercel.json git.deploymentEnabled:false) — deploying is an explicit, governed action
projects.git_connection: none — the CarUp Vercel projects have no connected Git repository (OC-P0 cost containment). Vercel therefore assigns no branch alias and injects no VERCEL_GIT_* variables; a release is a CLI upload of a clean detached worktree at the deploy commit (owner decision 2026-10-08).

database.role: canonical staging database (OC-5R DB convergence: SOURCE PASS + DATABASE PASS)
database.migrations: none introduced by OC-5R-REL-01 (no file under database/ changed); the read-only post-convergence manifest recertification is recorded in the release report

frontend.basis: a named preview alias assigned to the frontend deployment through the Vercel API and read back from Vercel (no branch alias exists for a Git-less deployment)

backend.basis: a named preview alias assigned to the backend deployment through the Vercel API and read back from Vercel

procedure: 1. Commit ONLY this branch's two pairing records (values above) plus candidate documentation on top of code_sha. Verify that commit with the verify command — it must pass with pairing "present". That commit is the deploy commit.

2. From a clean detached worktree at the deploy commit (git status empty; the CLI upload set is exactly the tracked tree), deploy carup-backend-staging to the PREVIEW target: vercel deploy --project carup-backend-staging -b CARUP_BUILD_SHA=<deploy commit> -b CARUP_BUILD_REF=<branch> -e CARUP_BUILD_SHA=<deploy commit> -e CARUP_BUILD_REF=<branch> -e COMMUNICATION_OUTBOUND_DISABLED=true -m carupSourceSha=<deploy commit>. Assign the backend alias above to that deployment and read it back.
3. The same for carup-staging (-b CARUP_BUILD_SHA / CARUP_BUILD_REF; the build pairs from the backend record); assign the frontend alias above and read it back.

4. Prove runtime identity before any journey: /carup-provenance.json and /api/health both serve the deploy commit, the frontend is paired to the backend alias, the database refs are the staging project only, OCR custody is canonical (cloudflare/Qwen), general AI is cloudflare/Gemma, and the outbound kill switch is active.
5. Run the deployed provider proof (label oc5r-deployed-provider-proof) and the two staging gates on the deploy commit.
